info.name: RightTouch - Scheduled Booking & Technician Job Handling
info.description: End-to-end collection for scheduled bookings and technician job handling: configurable slots, scheduled creation, reschedule/cancel, base location, grouped scheduled-job calendar, offer feed, accept/decline, travel/arrival/start, completion, technician cancellation/re-acceptance, admin slot configuration and base-location ops, and the Socket.IO event contract. Use with the RightTouch - Dispatch & Socket environment.

request.description: Sends a technician login OTP.
Verifies the technician OTP and captures technicianToken.
Sends a customer login OTP.
Verifies the customer OTP and captures customerToken.
Admin/Owner password login; captures adminToken.
Fetches the authenticated technician profile and captures technicianId for admin base-location requests.

Public slot options. Returns the instant option plus admin-configured scheduled days and slots (default: 5 days from tomorrow, four 3-hour slots 09:00-21:00), timezone, and supply-aware availability. Captures scheduledDate/scheduledTime and a second slot for rescheduling.
Same as the GPS variant but resolves the location from a customer-owned address. addressId is only used when latitude/longitude are absent.

Creates a scheduled booking for a saved customer address. The address must belong to the authenticated customer and include latitude/longitude. Set addressId before running; GPS coordinates are no longer sent by this request.

exec: if (!addressId || !String(addressId).trim()) { throw new Error('Set addressId to a saved customer address before running this request.'); }

request.description: Creates an instant booking for comparison with the scheduled flow. Captures bookingId. Requires an eligible online technician for a successful dispatch, but the booking row is created first.

Reschedules an unassigned scheduled booking. Only pending/broadcasted bookings with no technician can be moved. The new slot must differ from the current slot and must be more than RESCHEDULE_CUTOFF_MINUTES (default 300) away. Emits booking_rescheduled to the customer room and admin_dashboard.

Cancels a booking. Scheduled cancellations are free more than 3 hours before the slot; fees apply inside 3 hours and at the door. The assigned technician receives job_cancelled_by_customer when one exists.

item.name: Technician - Get My Service Base Location

request.description: Returns serviceBaseLocation (GeoJSON Point), its source/verification/update timestamp, fallback live location, and allowed districts/zones. Scheduled matching uses this point as the travel origin; live GPS is only a fallback.

item.name: Technician - Set My Service Base Location

request.description: Self-service base location. The server resolves district/zone and rejects coordinates outside the technician's approved districts. Self updates are recorded with source=self and verified=false.
Updates live GPS and may trigger matching. Rate-limited. For scheduled jobs the base location is the matching origin; live GPS is a fallback and is required for instant feed/accept flows.

Marks the technician online. Online presence is required for instant feed delivery and for accepting any job. Scheduled BROADCAST offers can be pushed while offline, but ACCEPT still requires online presence.
Registers a device push token. Offline scheduled offers rely on FCM because no live socket exists.

Returns the live offer feed. Scheduled offers appear only when scheduledOffersEnabled is not false, the dispatch window is open, the technician is eligible, and active/daily caps allow it. Captures bookingId and broadcastVersion for accept/decline.

request.description: Accepts the current offer version. Requires online presence and passes activation, active-job, feasibility, and claim guards. Returns 409 on version mismatch/taken/conflict and 410 when the offer expired.

Declines the current offer version. The decline is audit-logged and the technician is suppressed from immediate re-offer according to REOFFER_DECLINED_AFTER_MINUTES. Declining the last live offer can trigger an immediate rematch.
Moves an accepted job to on_the_way. For scheduled jobs this is the travel-start signal; reminders escalate when the technician has not started travel.

request.description: Scheduled jobs grouped by business date and time slot. Defaults to today through the last bookable day and active statuses (accepted, on_the_way, reached, in_progress). Optional query: date=YYYY-MM-DD or fromDate/toDate (max 31 days), status=accepted,on_the_way (comma separated), includeCompleted=true, includeCancelled=true, includeEmptySlots=false. Owner/Admin may pass technicianId or includeUnassigned=true.
Current active jobs for the technician.
Technician job history.

Technician cancels an assigned job. A configurable penalty is recorded on the technician wallet; the cancelling technician's broadcast is marked rejected so the same job is not immediately re-offered to them.
Re-accepts a job the technician previously cancelled. The server decides whether the admin-configured reaccept penalty applies; client-supplied penalty flags are ignored.
Lists approved technicians whose base location is missing, unverified, or still marked last_known. Optional districtId filter. Captures the first technicianId for the next requests.

item.name: 05 - Socket.IO Handshake & Event Reference

request.description: Proves the Socket.IO endpoint is reachable. Postman cannot speak the Socket.IO protocol; use a Socket.IO client with handshake.auth.token for event-level tests. See docs/02-socket-notifications.md and docs/04-scheduled-booking-and-technician-jobs.md for the scheduled-booking event sequence.

item.description: Scheduled-booking events to expect: technician job:new/technician:jobs_changed/job:expired/job_taken, customer booking:accepted/booking:reminder/booking_rescheduled/booking:rebroadcast, technician job_cancelled_by_customer, admin new_booking/booking_at_risk, and notification:new.

request.description: Expected 400. Verifies blank/whitespace coordinates are rejected before any district lookup.
Expected 4xx. Verifies version fencing. A 409 version_mismatch means refresh the feed; 410 means the offer expired; 403/404 means the technician is not eligible for this offer.
